text:
julia_support: FYI customer Neptune Logistics reported a returned outgoing wire. Bank return notes: "INVALID_IBAN_FORMAT" and "INTERMEDIARY_BANK_REQUIRED". Customer needs funds today, can we triage? Payment ID pmt_78a3c2
payments-bot: automated-return | payment_id=pmt_78a3c2 | reason=INVALID_IBAN_FORMAT | bank_note="Invalid IBAN checksum or format" | code=R03_RETURN
raj_payments: can you paste the exact beneficiary fields we sent? common culprits: spaces in IBAN or missing intermediary BIC for routed GBP/EUR wires. also any preprocessing logs?
julia_support: payload below (sanitized). note: customer pasted IBAN with spaces and leading zeros in local account before conversion.
```json
{
  "payment_id": "pmt_78a3c2",
  "beneficiary_name": "Neptune Logistics Ltd",
  "beneficiary_iban": "GB29 NWBK 6016 1331 9268 19",
  "beneficiary_bic": "NWBKGB2L",
  "amount": "12500.00",
  "currency": "GBP",
  "purpose": "supplier invoice 4532"
}
```
mike_engineer: I suspect our IBAN normalizer didn't strip spaces correctly or our checksum calc failed when we trimmed leading zeros elsewhere. quick repro: run the normalizer locally
```bash
python -c "from payments.normalize import normalize_iban; print(normalize_iban('GB29 NWBK 6016 1331 9268 19'))"
```
olivia_ops: customer wants an ETA. they explicitly said funds required by EOD. if we can retry manually once fixed, they'll authorize re-submission. pls confirm manual retry path and who needs to approve.
raj_payments: agree. steps: 1) confirm normalizer behavior 2) patch to preserve country code and digits when stripping whitespace 3) ensure we don't drop leading zeros for local-account segments 4) include intermediary bank field when SWIFT resolves to a correspondent with required intermediate. I'm going to open a PR branch payments/normalize-iban-space-safe
mike_engineer: taking ownership. I can reproduce locally: our current regex does `re.sub("\\D", "", s)` then int() cast in one spot which drops leading zeros for some rails. will change to keep string chars. I'll push a fix and a unit test with the payload above.
julia_support: customer has pre-signed consent to retry once we confirm. Case CS-99877 created: https://zendesk.example/org/CS-99877. please CC neptune@neptunelogistics.example on retry email.
payments-bot: deploy-event | branch=payments/normalize-iban-space-safe | status=ci_started | triggered_by=mike_engineer
raj_payments: can we do a canary deploy to staging then a small production canary for the next 30 mins? if green, retry as a new payment (do NOT reuse same payment_id). also add a fallback to require/interrogate intermediary_bic for GB->non-UK beneficiary banks.
mike_engineer: will do. plan: push fix, run unit tests, deploy canary to us-west-2 staging, smoke test using test account test-acc-113, then schedule manual retry workflow. ETA ~3h. I'll post logs here once done.
julia_support: thanks — I'll update the customer and hold until you post the retry confirmation. please flag if you need support ops on the manual submission form.
mike_engineer: quick note on the fix: changed `int()` conversion -> string-preserve and added IBAN normalization test vectors (spaces, lowercase, padded zeros). pushing in 2m.
raj_payments: noted. assigning to mike_engineer for hotfix/patch. if production canary passes, ops: please complete manual retry and set transaction meta `original_return_reason=INVALID_IBAN_FORMAT`.
julia_support: appreciated. I'll mark CS-99877 pending-retry and ping neptune when it's re-submitted. :thumbsup:
